description.vi: Kỹ năng nền tảng cho Nest: tự làm màn hình (mảnh) cho người dùng, trình bày giao diện gói và viết liên kết nest://.
description.en: Platform skills for Nest: make a screen (a piece) of your own for the person, present pack interfaces and write nest:// links.

skills.name: side-bar
skills.description: Use Nest's right tool area to present pack interfaces, keep conversation state, and choose suitable size/aspect.

skills.name: nest-links
skills.description: Write nest:// links in replies that open a data-pool collection or document, a Soot, a team, a screen of a pack, a drafted piece of work, a drafted Soot, team or schedule, a drafted change to a Soot or to tool approvals, or the Kênh chat settings for Telegram and Discord.

skills.name: nest-pieces
skills.description: Make a screen of your own in Nest (a piece) when a person keeps coming back for the same view or job: declare a tool that calls an outside service with a key the person enters in Nest, bind queries, named actions and questions, write the screen with the kit, read what each save answers, answer questions from the screen, fix or retire it, and propose a layout change.
